2607.15893.title: Induction in Both Directions: A Mechanistic Analysis of In-Context Learning in Masked Diffusion Language Models
2607.15893.paper_summary: While the internal mechanisms of autoregressive (AR) transformers have been studied extensively, much less is known about diffusion language models (DLMs), an emerging alternative that generates text by iterative denoising. In this work, we study how DLMs implement induction, a mechanism behind in-context learning in which the model finds a repeated context and copies the token that followed it. Our analysis compares attention-only AR models and absorbing-mask DLMs with matched architectures. We find that DLMs learn a bidirectional induction circuit, where previous-token and next-token heads write local context into the residual stream and later induction heads use it to find and copy the answer from the matching source position. The circuit is direction-symmetric, working whether the source appears in the past or in the future. When only left context is visible, matching what an AR model sees, the DLM does not outperform its AR counterpart in induction capabilities. However, we observe it has stronger induction when both sides of the masked token are visible, pointing to bidirectional context access rather than a stronger one-sided mechanism. Beyond induction, we provide causal evidence that DLMs compute the global fraction of masked tokens and use it as an implicit timestep, even though they are given no explicit timestep embedding.
2607.15893.paper_summary_zh: 雖然自回歸（AR）Transformer的內部機制已被廣泛研究，但對於擴散語言模型（DLMs）這一新興替代方案的了解則相對較少，該模型通過迭代去噪生成文本。在本研究中，我們探討了DLMs如何實現歸納，這是一種在上下文學習中起作用的機制，其中模型找到重複的上下文並複製其後的標記。我們的分析比較了僅使用注意力的AR模型和具有匹配架構的吸收掩碼DLMs。我們發現DLMs學習到了一個雙向歸納電路，其中前一標記和下一標記的頭部將局部上下文寫入殘差流中，然後歸納頭部使用它來從匹配的源位置找到並複製答案。該電路是方向對稱的，無論源出現在過去還是未來都能正常運作。當僅可見左側上下文時，與AR模型所見相匹配，DLM在歸納能力上並未超越其AR對應物。然而，我們觀察到當被掩碼的標記的兩側都可見時，它的歸納能力更強，這表明它具備雙向上下文訪問，而不是僅僅是更強的單向機制。除了歸納之外，我們提供了因果證據，表明DLMs計算被掩碼標記的全局比例並將其用作隱式時間步，即使它們並未獲得明確的時間步嵌入。
2607.15893.author: Andy Catruna et.al.
